originStory.title: Why I Created This Masterclass
originStory.story: When Anthropic released the Model Context Protocol in late 2024, I immediately saw its potential. With **10,000+ notes** in my `Obsidian` vault and a **20-year** IT career behind me, I understood what this meant: AI was finally getting a proper integration layer. I dove deep into `MCP`, tested dozens of servers, figured out what works and what doesn't, and realized most tutorials were written for developers. Knowledge workers were being left behind. This masterclass bridges that gap.

creatorJourney.title: Built by a Knowledge Management Expert
creatorJourney.story: I've spent **20+ years** in IT as a Solution Architect and Systems Engineer. My passion is knowledge management; I've published **10,000+ notes** publicly and built the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit). When `MCP` emerged, I was an early adopter. I've tested the ecosystem extensively, identified the reliable servers, discovered the GUI tools that make setup painless, and mapped out the security considerations most people miss. This masterclass distills months of exploration into a clear path for knowledge workers.
achievements: **20+ years** IT experience (Solution Architect, Systems Engineer)

before.title: Before MCP
before.description: Every AI interaction started with manual work: copy this note, paste it, copy that file, paste it. Your knowledge was trapped in silos. Websites without APIs were untouchable. You spent more time preparing context than getting answers.

during.title: Learning MCP
during.description: You discover `MCP` isn't as technical as it sounds. GUI tools like `Dockmaster` and `Toolbase` make installation simple. You connect your first server, `Obsidian`, and watch `Claude` read your notes directly. Then web search. Then browser control. Each server multiplies what AI can do.

after.title: After Mastery
after.description: AI becomes your research assistant and workflow automator. You set up cross-tool workflows: AI reads your `Obsidian` notes, searches the web, fills forms on sites without APIs. You focus on thinking while AI handles data retrieval.

methodology.title: How This Masterclass Works
methodology.philosophy: Most MCP tutorials are written by developers, for developers. They assume you're comfortable with npm, JSON configs, and command line tools. This masterclass takes a different approach: it's designed for knowledge workers who want results without the technical overhead.

vision.title: The Future of AI Integration
vision.mission: MCP is becoming a standard for AI integrations. OpenAI adopted it in March 2025. The ecosystem is growing monthly. Learning now means you're building on a foundation that grows with the ecosystem. Every new server, every new client, every new capability adds to what you can do.
vision.biggerPicture: We're moving from 'AI as chatbot' to 'AI as operating system for knowledge work.' MCP is the integration layer that makes this possible. Early adopters aren't just saving time today; they're positioning themselves for a future where AI automation is a core professional skill.
